findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Same switch on DataSourceType repeated in 3 repository methods (plus a 4th branch in SystemController) [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Modifiability, ISO-30]

evidence.excerpt: return dataSourceType.ToLowerInvariant() switch  (2 and 3 of 3: CreateConnection, GetResetScript)

findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-07
findings.recommendation: Introduce one per-provider abstraction (e.g. an IDataSourceProvider with SqlServer/PostgreSQL implementations supplying connection string, connection and reset script) selected once. Apply Replace Conditional with Polymorphism (FRC-06, https://refactoring.com/catalog/replaceConditionalWithPolymorphism.html).

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Repository catches System.Exception without a filter (twice) and drops the original exception [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Analysability, ISO-29]
findings.recommendation: Catch the provider exceptions you can handle (DbException, ConfigurationException) or add an exception filter, and pass the caught exception as InnerException of UserException; let the UnhandledExceptionMiddleware boundary handle the rest.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: TestingService is a pass-through Middle Man that only forwards to the repository [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Analysability, ISO-29]

evidence.excerpt: public async Task<RetrieveResponse<int>> ResetTestingAsync(...) { return await testingRepository.ResetTestingAsync(cancellationToken); }

findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-23
findings.recommendation: Either give the service real responsibility (e.g. environment guard for the reset, result mapping) or document the deliberate closed-layer choice; otherwise apply Remove Middle Man (FRC-19, https://refactoring.com/catalog/removeMiddleMan.html).

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Misleading names: a delete result typed as RetrieveResponse, and 'PilotUtilty' folder names inconsistent with 'PilotUtility' projects

evidence.excerpt: public async Task<RetrieveResponse<int>> ResetTestingAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
/// A result for a data source retrieve. ... public class RetrieveResponse<TReturn>

findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-32
findings.recommendation: Use an intention-revealing result type for write operations (e.g. OperationResponse<T>) and fix the 'PilotUtilty' spelling so folder and project names agree. Apply Rename (FRC-22, https://refactoring.com/catalog/changeFunctionDeclaration.html).

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Connection and transaction managed with try/finally Close() instead of using declarations; transaction never disposed

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Use 'using var connection = ...' and 'using var transaction = ...' (the .editorconfig already prefers csharp_prefer_simple_using_statement) and drop the Close() finally block.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Nullable annotations are used but key nullable warnings are downgraded to suggestions
findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-36
findings.recommendation: Restore CS8602/CS8604 to warning (or error) and fix the flagged dereferences, e.g. DataSources?.Find vs DataSources.FirstOrDefault usage.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Private fields use camelCase without the _ prefix and no .editorconfig naming rule documents this convention

evidence.excerpt: private readonly ILogger<UnhandledExceptionMiddleware> logger; private readonly RequestDelegate next;

findings.recommendation: Either rename private fields to _camelCase or add a dotnet_naming_rule for private fields in .editorconfig that documents the this.camelCase convention.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No CODEOWNERS file on a GitHub repository, so pipeline and build files have no required code-owner review
findings.recommendation: Add .github/CODEOWNERS with a '*' rule (or at least rules for .github/workflows/ and Directory.Build.props) naming the maintainers, and require code-owner review on main.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No SECURITY.md security policy in the root, .github/ or docs/
findings.recommendation: Add a SECURITY.md giving a private reporting channel (email or GitHub private vulnerability reporting), the handling process and disclosure timelines, and supported versions.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Workflow declares no permissions block, so the GITHUB_TOKEN inherits the repository default scopes
findings.recommendation: Add a top-level 'permissions: contents: read' (or 'permissions: {}') and grant any write scopes only on the jobs that need them.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Actions are pinned to mutable tags (@v4) rather than full commit SHAs
findings.recommendation: Pin each action to its full 40-character commit SHA with a version comment (e.g. actions/checkout@<sha> # v4.x.y) and let an update bot keep the pins current.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No SAST tool runs in CI on pull requests or pushes

evidence.excerpt:
run: dotnet restore
...
run: dotnet build --no-restore
...
run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Add a CodeQL workflow (github/codeql-action init + analyze for csharp) on pull_request and push to main, uploading SARIF results, with a defined severity threshold that blocks merge.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Compiler warnings are not treated as errors in the shared build configuration
findings.recommendation: Set <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> (at least for CI builds, e.g. via ContinuousIntegrationBuild) and an explicit <AnalysisLevel> in Directory.Build.props.

findings.subject: Twelve-Factor
findings.title: Production config writes rolling log files via the Serilog File sink
findings.recommendation: Remove the File sink (path, rolling and retention settings) from the base appsettings.json and keep only the Console sink and OTLP exporter; if file logging is wanted locally, move it into appsettings.Development.json.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Spec documents /testing/reset but the controller route is /v{version}/testing/reset
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the committed spec from the running app (or fix the route) so the documented path matches the implemented route exactly.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: show-details is [BindRequired] in code but optional with a default in the spec
findings.recommendation: Decide whether the parameter is optional; either drop [BindRequired] (keeping the default) or mark it required: true in the spec without a default.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: AboutResponse.ApplicationConfiguration is returned but absent from the spec schema

evidence.excerpt:
[JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)]
public IApplicationConfiguration? ApplicationConfiguration { get; set; }

findings.recommendation: Add the applicationConfiguration property (with its schema) to AboutResponse in the spec, or stop returning it.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: 500 ProblemDetails responses from the exception middleware are not documented
findings.recommendation: Document the error responses every operation can return (e.g. a `default` response with the error schema).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Reset action uses a path segment instead of the :action pattern
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-069
findings.recommendation: Expose the action as `POST /<collection>:reset` (e.g. `/testing-data:reset`) rather than a `/reset` sub-path.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Error bodies do not use the standard { error: { code, message } } structure

evidence.excerpt: var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails { Status = ..., Title = "Internal Server Error", Detail = uExc.Message, ...

Response.Headers.Append("Warning", response.ErrorMessage ?? "An error occurred");
return BadRequest();

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-046
findings.recommendation: Return one error body shape everywhere with `error.code` and `error.message` (extra fields allowed), and put the message in the body rather than a Warning header.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Error responses carry no x-ms-error-code header
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-044
findings.recommendation: Set an `x-ms-error-code` header on every error response, matching `error.code` in the body.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Synchronous POST action returns 204 instead of 200 with a body
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-017
findings.recommendation: Always return 200 with a JSON object body (e.g. `{ "deletedCount": 0 }`) from the reset action.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Service-side reset failures are reported as 400 with an empty body
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-031
findings.recommendation: Return a 5xx for failures the caller cannot fix (400 only for invalid requests), with a diagnosable error body.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: API version is placed in the URL path
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-088
findings.recommendation: Remove the `v{version}` path segment and the URL-segment reader; carry the version in the `api-version` query parameter.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: api-version is not required on every operation
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-085
findings.recommendation: Require the `api-version` query parameter on all operations and document it in the spec.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Missing api-version silently falls back to a default instead of returning 400
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-087
findings.recommendation: Set AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified to false and return 400 with code `MissingApiVersionParameter` / `UnsupportedApiVersionValue`.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: API versions are numeric (1.0) rather than date-based
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-086
findings.recommendation: Use `YYYY-MM-DD` version values (with `-preview` for previews).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Query parameter show-details is kebab-case, not camelCase
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-020
findings.recommendation: Rename the query parameter to `showDetails` (and update the spec).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: AboutResponse can serialize null-valued fields
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-054
findings.recommendation: Omit null fields from responses (e.g. JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull on the DTO or globally).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: deployDate is an unformatted string passed through from an environment variable
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-058
findings.recommendation: Parse the deploy date and emit it as an RFC 3339 date-time (`format: date-time` in the spec).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: No x-ms-request-id is generated or returned, including on error responses
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-027
findings.recommendation: Generate an opaque request ID per request, return it in an `x-ms-request-id` response header (documented in the spec) and include it in error logs.

findings.subject: Security / Identity & Access
findings.title: No authentication or authorization configured; every controller is explicitly [AllowAnonymous] (no deny-by-default)
findings.recommendation: Add an authentication scheme and AddAuthorization with a FallbackPolicy requiring authenticated users, call UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization, and keep [AllowAnonymous] only on truly public endpoints such as healthcheck (ATZ-02, T10-01).

findings.subject: Security / Identity & Access
findings.title: Destructive POST /v1/testing/reset and configuration details on /about?show-details=true are callable anonymously

evidence.excerpt: [HttpPost] [Route("reset")] ... public async Task<IActionResult> ResetTesting(...) { var response = await testingService.ResetTestingAsync(cancellationToken);
[FromQuery(Name = "show-details"), BindRequired] bool showDetails ... ApplicationConfiguration = showDetails ? new ApplicationConfiguration(this.ApplicationConfiguration, true) : null

findings.recommendation: Protect the reset and configuration-detail operations with a named policy or role (e.g. [Authorize(Policy = "TestAdmin")]) and, for reset, also restrict it to non-production environments (T10-04).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HSTS is never enabled (no UseHsts/AddHsts) while production has no HTTPS enforcement
findings.standard: OWASP HTTP Security Response Headers Cheat Sheet — HDR-07
findings.recommendation: Call app.UseHsts() outside Development with AddHsts(o => { o.MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(63072000); o.IncludeSubDomains = true; }) (DNW-03), or serve the API over HTTPS only (DNW-04); if a proxy adds HSTS, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Swagger UI / Scalar pages have no framing protection (frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options)
findings.standard: OWASP HTTP Security Response Headers Cheat Sheet — HDR-01
findings.recommendation: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' (CSP-11) plus X-Frame-Options: DENY on HTML responses; if a reverse proxy adds these, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development; production pipeline has no HTTPS enforcement
findings.standard: OWASP Transport Layer Security Cheat Sheet — TLS-03
findings.recommendation: Invert the condition so production calls UseHttpsRedirection (DNW-02) and, for API endpoints, configure Kestrel to listen on HTTPS only or reject HTTP with 400 (DNW-01, TLS-04, RST-01); if a reverse proxy enforces HTTPS, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: API responses carry no Cache-Control: no-store or frame-ancestors 'none' headers

evidence.excerpt: [Route("about")] ... public IActionResult About([FromQuery(Name = "show-details"), BindRequired] bool showDetails = false)

findings.standard: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet — RST-07
findings.recommendation: Add middleware setting Cache-Control: no-store and Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' (RST-08) on API responses, at least for configuration-detail responses such as /about?show-details=true.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: OpenAPI document, Scalar and Swagger UI are exposed in all environments despite an acknowledged production gate

evidence.excerpt: // production code would include the following check to only enable OpenApi in development environments //if (webApp.Environment.IsDevelopment()) webApp.MapOpenApi()

findings.recommendation: Wrap MapOpenApi, MapScalarApiReference and UseSwaggerUI in an IsDevelopment() (or explicit configuration flag) check so unnecessary documentation endpoints are disabled in production.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: CI workflow runs no secret-detection scan before merge

evidence.excerpt: steps: checkout, setup-dotnet, dotnet restore, dotnet build, dotnet test

findings.standard: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet — SMG-05
findings.recommendation: Add a secret-scanning step (e.g. gitleaks or GitHub secret scanning/push protection) to the pull_request workflow and a matching pre-commit hook.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: SQL Server connection string disables server-certificate validation while sending database credentials
findings.standard: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet — SMG-11
findings.recommendation: Remove TrustServerCertificate=True (or make it a development-only setting) and require encrypted connections with certificate validation for both SQL Server and PostgreSQL credential exchanges.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Base appsettings.json (all environments) carries development data-source values
findings.standard: OWASP Secure Code Review Cheat Sheet — SCR-02
findings.recommendation: Keep development host/user values only in appsettings.Development.json and leave the base file with empty or environment-supplied values so production cannot silently inherit development settings.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: coverlet.collector is referenced but CI never collects or publishes coverage

evidence.excerpt:
- name: Test
  run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Run `dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"` in CI and publish the result (reportgenerator step, coverage artifact or Codecov upload) so untested code is visible; no percentage gate is required.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Placeholder Assert.Pass test and tests whose arrange contradicts their name cannot catch the defects they claim to cover (3 tests)
findings.recommendation: Remove the Assert.Pass placeholder (or replace it with a real test), stub a null ErrorMessage and assert the default Warning value, and either build a null-result response or rename the null-result test.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Repository data access is never tested against a real database engine
findings.recommendation: Add an integration test project that runs TestingRepository.ResetTestingAsync against a containerized SQL Server/PostgreSQL (e.g. Testcontainers) with a fresh database per run.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Deployable Web API has no automated load or performance tests

evidence.excerpt:
- name: Test
  run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Add a scripted load test (k6, NBomber or similar) for the API's critical endpoints with pass/fail thresholds, run on a schedule or in the pipeline.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Error correlation ID is a fresh random GUID unrelated to the trace ID and only embedded in message text
findings.recommendation: Derive the correlation ID from Activity.Current.TraceId (fall back to a GUID only when no activity exists) and log it as its own template property (e.g. {CorrelationId}) so the user-facing ID links directly to the trace and logs.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: OTLP exporter scheme and protocol are hard-coded, overriding OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* configuration
findings.recommendation: Take the full endpoint (including scheme) and protocol from configuration, or leave Endpoint unset when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is provided, so TLS and protocol can change per environment without a code change.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Only health endpoint returns a constant 200 and never reflects the required database dependency
findings.recommendation: Register AddHealthChecks() with a timed, read-only SQL Server/PostgreSQL check tagged "ready", and map separate shallow liveness and readiness endpoints that return 503 when the active data source is unreachable.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: No SLOs or SLIs documented for the service
findings.recommendation: Document availability and p95 latency SLOs for the API with their SLIs (e.g. based on http.server.request.duration) and an observation window.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: .NET SDK version is not pinned (no global.json); build tooling floats to whatever SDK is installed
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-15
findings.recommendation: Add a global.json at the repository root pinning the .NET 10 SDK version (with an explicit rollForward policy such as latestPatch) so builds use a known toolchain.

findings.subject: Operations / Reliability
findings.title: Database calls in the request path have no transient-fault retry

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); connection.Open(); ... result = await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<int>(command);

findings.recommendation: Add a bounded retry with exponential back-off and jitter for transient DB errors only (e.g. SqlClient configurable retry logic / Npgsql retry, or a Polly pipeline registered once in DI), wrapping the whole transaction.

findings.subject: Operations / Reliability
findings.title: No circuit breaker around the synchronous database dependency on the request path
findings.recommendation: Register a shared resilience pipeline (retry inside a circuit breaker) once in DI for the active data source and handle BrokenCircuitException with a clear 503-style error.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: README does not link CONTRIBUTING.md or the docs/ content

evidence.excerpt: ## License ... see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

findings.recommendation: Add a 'Contributing' and 'Further documentation' section linking CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/PilotUtilityApi_v1.json and the architecture instructions.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Documented project structure uses folder names that do not exist (PilotUtilityApi.* vs actual PilotUtiltyApi.*)
findings.recommendation: Rename the src/ and test/ folders to PilotUtilityApi.* (updating the .sln paths), or correct the README tree to the actual folder names.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Project folder names are misspelled and inconsistent with their project names
findings.recommendation: Make every project folder name match its project/assembly name (PilotUtilityApi.*) so the one-project-per-folder convention is applied consistently.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: No local database setup steps or local stack for the required SQL Server/PostgreSQL

evidence.excerpt:
- One of the following databases:
  - **SQL Server** ...
  - **PostgreSQL** (version 12+)

findings.recommendation: Add steps (or a docker-compose file) to create the NorthWind database, schema, DevUser login and test tables the reset script expects.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING does not say how to build, format or test before submitting

evidence.excerpt:
## Pull Request Process
1. Ensure any install or build dependencies are removed before the end of the layer...

findings.recommendation: Add a pre-submit step listing `dotnet build`, `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet test`, and drop the unrelated container-layer boilerplate.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING does not state coding conventions or point to .editorconfig
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Coding conventions' section pointing to .editorconfig and .github/instructions/architecture.instructions.md.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Versioned API has no CHANGELOG or release notes

evidence.excerpt: Increase the version numbers ... The versioning scheme we use is [SemVer](http://semver.org/).

findings.recommendation: Add a root CHANGELOG.md with dated per-version entries (starting at 1.0.1) and link it from the README.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Significant decisions (Dapper, multi-database, layering) are not recorded with context and consequences

evidence.excerpt:
## Data and persistence requirements ...
- Use Dapper persistence technology.

findings.recommendation: Add docs/adr/ with short ADRs (context, decision, consequences) for Dapper, SQL Server/PostgreSQL switching and the layer structure.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: README run/config paths point to src/PilotUtilityApi.Web, which does not exist
findings.recommendation: Change the README paths to src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web (or rename the folder), and align the inconsistent example ports (58701, 58401, 7000) with launch settings.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Versions in docs disagree with the project version (0.1.1 / 1.0.0 vs 1.0.1)
findings.recommendation: Update the README example and regenerate docs/PilotUtilityApi_v1.json so both show 1.0.1, matching Directory.Build.props and appsettings.json.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING links a README anchor (#copilot-customization) that does not exist
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Copilot Customization' section to the README describing .github/copilot-instructions.md and instructions/, or remove the link.
